name: latex-posters
tagline_zh: 让 Claude 帮你搞创作：latex-posters。英文简介见下。
desc_en: Create professional research posters in LaTeX using beamerposter, tikzposter, or baposter. Support for conference presentations, academic posters, and scientific communication. Includes layout design, color schemes, multi-column formats, figure integration, and poster-specific best practices for visual communication.
